surface_value: Affidavit sworn on 15 February 2006 by the appellant claiming she had contributed $37,000 out of a total purchase price of $67,000 paid for the property, that the balance had been funded by an advance from Commonwealth Bank of Australia to the appellant and the bankrupt and that she had paid all the monies due under the mortgage.
